label: Clock hour minute subdivision
adaptation_note: Twelve-hour position overview plus twelve consistently oriented five-minute details preserve the 12-to-60 subdivision. Shared endpoints are explicitly accounted for; no hands added.
acceptance_requirement: Distinguish intervals from boundary ticks and preserve the 12-to-60 relationship. This is a sequential lesson, not a replacement full sixty-tick dial.

frames.title: Twelve-hour dial overview
frames.teaching_key: Twelve major hour positions around the dial; twelve is at the top and order is clockwise. Minute ticks are intentionally supplied in the twelve following interval details. There are no hands and no time reading. The interval details unroll one arc into a straight segment.

frames.title: Minute interval 0–5
frames.teaching_key: Clockwise interval from hour position 12 to 1, corresponding to minutes 0 through 5. Six boundary marks enclose five equal minute intervals; the two long marks are neighbouring hour positions. End boundaries are shared with adjacent frames and must not be counted twice. Minute 60 returns to minute zero. This is an enlarged, unrolled detail, not a straight clock face.
